exercises.q: Дурные вести, как вода, просачиваются сквозь ___ (малая скважина, acc. pl.).
exercises.why: **скважина → скважины** (acc. pl.). Feminine, inanimate; nominative plural скважины; declines like DLI's слова (hard stem): A. слова. Ending -а → -ы.  **малый → малейшие** (acc. pl., agreeing with скважины). Adjective type I, hard — declines like DLI's новые: A. anim. = G., inan. = N.. Ending -ые → -ейшие.  Declension: sg. скважина · скважины · скважине · скважину · скважиной · скважине; pl. скважины · скважин · скважинам · скважины · скважинами · скважинах.  «The accusative plural of inanimate nouns is the same as the nominative plural. The accusative plural of animate nouns is the same as the genitive plural.» — DLI, Lesson 42.  «All adjectives agree in gender, number and case with the noun they modify.» — DLI, Lesson 47.  «Notice that the adjectives of the "soft", "guttural" and "sibilant" types are declined in the plural in the very same way.» — DLI, Lesson 48.  Adjectives in the accusative: animate = genitive, inanimate = nominative (masculine and plural); feminine -ую, -юю. — DLI, Lessons 46–47.  — Model words and rules from the DLI Grammar Reference Book; forms from the OpenCorpora dictionary (CC BY-SA 4.0).

exercises.q: Стреляет, но прямой наводкой, без прицела, целимся через ___ (дуло, acc. sg.).
exercises.why: **дуло → дуло** (acc. sg.). Neuter, nominative singular in -о — declines like DLI's окно: A. окно. Ending -о → -о.  Declension: sg. дуло · дула · дулу · дуло · дулом · дуле; pl. дула · дул · дулам · дула · дулами · дулах.  «The accusative of masculine animate nouns is the same as the genitive. The accusative of masculine inanimate nouns and of all neuter nouns is the same as the nominative.» — DLI, Lesson 32.  — Model words and rules from the DLI Grammar Reference Book; forms from the OpenCorpora dictionary (CC BY-SA 4.0).
